title: Performance and hardening
goal: All performance and robustness budgets hold on every target; the long tail found by extended fuzzing is fixed.
scope: 100 000 fuzz sequences per desktop target, 10 000 per mobile target
50k-word stress document; memory growth; 1-hour scripted typing session
Minified vs dev parity; size reduction where possible

rules.rule: No gate or threshold relaxed without Joel.

metrics: p95 ≤ 8 ms desktop / ≤ 33 ms mobile on 50k words

criteria: Extended fuzz: 0 violations on all targets.
Latency p95 ≤ 8 ms desktop and ≤ 33 ms mobile on the 50k-word doc.
Heap after a 1-hour session within 2× of the heap after load.
